rules.name: Dodge (4+)
rules.description: This unit has a 4+ Feel no Pain when engaged in Combat.

rules.name: Herald of Ynnead
rules.description: When this unit benefits from the Strength from Death special rule, it gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic in addition to other bonuses.

rules.name: Runesuit
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

rules.name: Gyrinx Familiar
rules.description: Once per Battle Round, when this unit would suffer a Peril of the Warp, the Peril result is treated as having rolled a 1 on the chart.

rules.name: Warden of Yvraine
rules.description: During deployment, if Yvraine, the Herald of Ynnead is in your army, you may permanently attach this unit to Yvraine, Herald of Ynnead. The two are now treated as 1 unit. This does not prevent the unit from Attaching to other eligible units during Deployment or the battle.

selectionEntries.name: Asu-Var, The Sword of Silent Screams

profiles.name: Asu-Var, The Sword of Silent Screams

rules.name: Ancient Warsuit
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has a 2+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

rules.name: Inevitable Death
rules.description: Once per Battle Round, when any unit on the Battlefield would be slain and removed from play or become a wreck, before removing the model, you may remove the Yncarne from the battlefield. Place the Yncarne back on the Battlefield anywhere within 6” of the slain/wrecked model and then remove any slain models.

rules.name: Spirit Storm
rules.description: This model has a 3+ Armour Save.

rules.name: Avatar of Ynnead
rules.description: Ynnari Eldar units which can draw visibility to this model may use its Leadership (LD) characteristic instead of their own. In addition, the unit gains the Gaze of Ynnead Psychic Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Strength from Death
sharedRules.description: In a turn in which any unit dies (friend or foe), a unit with this special rule gains +1 to their Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics until the start of the next turn.

sharedRules.name: Sorrow
sharedRules.description: If a unit suffers an un-saved wound inflicted by this weapon, it must make a Panic Test regardless of whether the target units side won the Combat.

sharedRules.name: Silence
sharedRules.description: A unit which suffers 1 or more hits from a weapon with this special rule halves their Leadership (LD) characteristic until the end of the Phase. In addition, units hit by this weapon do not gain the benefit of the Stubborn special rule.

rules.name: Favoured of Ynnead
rules.description: A unit with this Warlord Trait and any attached unit always count as gaining the benefit of the Strength from Death.

rules.name: Master of Death
rules.description: A model with this warlord trait gains the Murderous Strike (6+) on all weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Lord of Rebirth
rules.description: A model with this trait gains the Regeneration and Feel no Pain (5+) special rules.

rules.name: Ancestors Grace
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly unit within 24” of the Psyker. That unit counts as gaining the benefit of the Strength from Death special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase even if no units were slain and removed from play this turn.

rules.name: Word of the Pheonix
rules.description: When this power is cast, select a single friendly Infantry, Automata or Monster unit within 24” of the Psyker. One model in the target unit heals 1 wound. If the unit has no wounds to be healed, the unit regains 1 lost model with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Shield of Ynnead
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain a 4+ Invulnerable save until the start of your next Shooting Phase.
